content:
maria: FYI customer (acme-inc) onboarding — first-login SSO failing consistently, 403 at our ACS. They say IdP metadata just uploaded.

maria: Log snippet shows `Assertion recipient mismatch` and `Unknown ACS URL`. Debugging with them now.

sachin: Can you paste the metadata blob they uploaded? Do we have any normalization checks for trailing slashes?

maria: Pasted below (redacted certs):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.example.com">
  <SSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService index="0" Location="https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs"/>
    <AssertionConsumerService index="1" Location="https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs/"/>
  </SSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

emily: Oh — two ACS entries with and without trailing slash. Our ACS canonicalization historically prefers exact match. Customer's SP config uses the non-slash URL. Their IdP is selecting the trailing-slash binding.

jordan: We saw similar in #4312345678 but that was internal. Do we accept multiple ACS urls and compare normalized URIs?

emily: Currently we match against allowed ACS set exactly. We do a string compare, we don't normalize multiple slashes, nor strip trailing slash.

maria: Customer repro steps they followed:
1) SSO metadata upload via console (they uploaded IdP XML).
2) Hit app login -> IdP redirects POST to `https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs/` (note trailing slash).
3) Our front end returns 403 with log: `auth.sso: recipient_uri=https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs/ rejected recipient-check`.

maria: Quick log lines:
```
[2026-03-16T15:02:41Z] auth.sso DEBUG incoming_assertion recipient=https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs/ binding=POST
[2026-03-16T15:02:41Z] auth.sso WARN recipient_check_failed expected_set=[https://app.acme.example.com/sso/acs]
```

sachin: Workaround for now: add both ACS variants to the customer's allowed ACS list in the tenant config. I can do that if you confirm.

maria: Customer is ok with quick workaround but would prefer platform fix.

emily: Suggested long-term fix: normalize ACS urls when uploading metadata and when validating assertions. Normalize rules: strip trailing slash for comparison, lower-case host, preserve path semantics. Also add a migration that adds alternate forms when metadata contains multiple ACS entries.

jordan: We should also check the metadata watcher for idp cert rotation corner cases — if their metadata has multiple keyDescriptors maybe watcher picks the wrong one. Any cert expiry in blob?

maria: I inspected certificate: expires 2026-08-01, fine for now. No rotation issue in this instance.

eng-bot: Deployment note: can create patch to auth service to allow normalized recipient matches. Hotfix rolling deploy estimate ~30m (unit-tests + canary).

maria: Proposed immediate plan:
- sachin: add both ACS URLs to tenant config as a short-term fix (consent from customer) -> owner sachin
- emily/jordan: implement normalization in auth.sso check + unit test -> owner emily
- eng-sre: small canary deploy, monitor 5xx/403 rate for tenant -> ping @eng-sre
- maria: update support ticket with repro and ETA

sachin: Adding alternate ACS entries now. I will post the exact change.

maria: Customer confirmed they can wait for platform fix but accepted the interim change.

emily: I'll sketch the code change: in RecipientChecker.normalize(uri): `uri = uri.trim(); uri = uri.replaceAll("/$","")` then compare normalized values. Will add a config flag `sso.normalize_recipient=true` to roll out gradually.

jordan: Also add a small integration test that posts samlResponse to both variants.

maria: Thanks — will follow up once canary is up. If any blocker, notify #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: Metadata uploaded: idp.acme.example.com by acme-admin at 2026-03-16T15:01:20Z (watcher-id: 87bff3).

maria: Closing loop: sachin changed tenant config at 2026-03-16T15:10:05Z — they can now login. emily will own platform fix and provide timeline.

jordan: Leave a note in the deploy changelog and instrument a recipient-normalization metric so we can count how many assertions needed normalization.

maria: Created support follow-up ticket with remediation steps and linked engineering PR when available.

emily: ETA for PR -> tomorrow EOD PST. Will post PR link here when created.

maria: Thanks everyone.
